name: Paranormal Cleaner
storyline:
You took a job cleaning houses after dark. The company gave you a van, a few tools, and a checklist. The first few shifts are ordinary enough.

In Paranormal Cleaner, you take on first-person cleaning jobs that get stranger the longer you work. Pick three tools from your van, mop floors, vacuum rugs, and haul rubbish out to the bin. Then a cupboard you just shut opens again. An unplugged washer starts knocking. And the dolls in the back room seem to be paying attention.

Between shifts, check your email for new assignments and spend your pay on supplies. A candle can help you see in the dark. A wooden cross might come in handy when a house has more than dirt to deal with.

Finish enough of the checklist to get paid, then decide how much longer you want to stay.
summary: Take late-night cleaning jobs in a first-person horror game. Load up your van, mop floors, vacuum rugs, and take out the rubbish. When a cupboard opens by itself or an unplugged washer starts knocking, decide how much of the checklist is worth finishing.
